delay.note: the existing figure is a sum of cascaded time constants, not a propagation delay; it is an order-of-magnitude comparison only

system_delay.equation: t_stop = t_CT/rectifier/filter + t_cmp + t_common_logic + max(t_primary, t_SR)
system_delay.common_logic_note: read from D0's own budget, not re-derived here; the two paths differ by the U11F inverter, and the figure stays a floor because U6.4 publishes no maximum

sr_branch_terms.excluded_input_rc_reason: the 10 us RC is the validation board's front end, not the main board's fault path

system_delay.note: the 121x module figure is a detection-only comparison; against the whole machine the comparator change is worth the ratio below, because the REG crowbar sets the stop time
system_delay.comparison_caveat: the two detection terms are not of one kind: the module's 1.06 us is a worst case over -40..+125 C, while the filtered path's 128.9 us is a sum of cascaded time constants plus the LM393's typical delay. The decode and latch added to each are maxima, so the existing total is still the optimistic side

supply.isolation: D3 BAT54W between J1.1 V5 and V5I; VF <= 0.40 V at the module's load current
supply.shutdown_logic: SHDN low enables; within 0.9 V of V+ disables
supply.loss_of_5v: D3 keeps the backfeed off the connector and R7 is the only element that can raise FAST_EXT_N; with J1.1 at 0 V the receiver's 100k holds the line low through Q1 or R7's open top. The rail itself can still be backfed through D2, so the state is proved by the bench matrix, not by this note
supply.minimum_reference_current: UNVERIFIED - the LM4040DBZ-2.5 minimum operating current is not in this repository

backfeed.problem: with J1.1 open, D2 turns the OCD divider into a supply for the dead rail; R7 was referenced to that rail, so the healthy level depended on the backfeed
backfeed.available_current_basis: 132.0 A common-mode limit (13.2 V burden), rail at 0 V
backfeed.rail_state_below_minimum: UNSPECIFIED - the TLV3501 datasheet stops at 2.7 V, so neither the output level nor the supply current is bounded there
backfeed.mitigation: D3 feeds V5I from J1.1 and blocks the connector from being backfed; R7 stays on the connector net, so a lost J1.1 leaves FAST_EXT_N low whatever D2 does to V5I
backfeed.structural_invariant: FAST_EXT_N can only be raised by R7, and R7's top is the V5 connector net; Q1 only pulls down
backfeed.residual: an open D3, or a comparator whose supply pin is open while J1.1 is live, still leaves R7 able to raise the line; a pull-up cannot detect its own load disappearing

backfeed_verification.hardware: none - the module has no built board

fixture.supply: isolated, current-limited 5.0 V on J1.1 (limit <= 100 mA)
fixture.ocd_source: isolated, current-limited 0-15 V on J1.3; set the limit to 20 mA (the divider draws at most OCD/30k)
fixture.v5_open: break the J1.1 wire at the module end; do not remove PGND
fixture.signal_open: break J1.4 at the module end; the receiver keeps its 100k
fixture.receiver: D0 J10.4 / U11F / U19 (or an equivalent 4000B inverter and OR on the bench); D0 has a schematic but no PCB
fixture.loads: 10k from FAST_EXT_N to PGND models the module's own R7 return path; 100k to PGND models D0's pull-down (the receiver input)
fixture.instruments: >= 4 channels, 100 MHz; differential probe for VGS if the SR path is connected; series ammeter on J1.1 (uA range for the open-wire cases)

cases.name: healthy baseline
cases.setup: J1.1 5.0 V, OCD 0 V, all wires intact
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N = 5 V x 100k/110k = 4.55 V; FAST_COMBINED low; PERMIT high; I(V5) = bias + quiescent + R7
cases.pass_criteria: 4.2 V <= FAST_EXT_N <= 4.8 V and PERMIT high

cases.name: trip baseline
cases.setup: J1.1 5.0 V, OCD 7.5 V (75 A), all wires intact
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N < 0.4 V; FAST_COMBINED high; PERMIT low
cases.pass_criteria: Q1 pulls the line below 0.4 V within 1.1 us

cases.name: J1.1 open, OCD low
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N <= 0.3 V (100k), FAST_COMBINED high, PERMIT low, I(V5) = 0

cases.name: J1.1 open, OCD high (the backfeed case)
cases.setup: J1.1 wire open, OCD 15 V (150 A), the design absolute maximum; C1 discharged before the step
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N <= 0.3 V because R7's top is the connector net; V5I may rise through D2 but must not reach the connector (measure J1.1 = 0 V)
cases.pass_criteria: line <= 0.3 V, PERMIT low, I into J1.1 = 0, and V(V5I) recorded (any value is a result, not a pass)

cases.name: signal wire open, module powered
cases.setup: J1.4 open at the module end, J1.1 5.0 V
cases.expected: receiver input is pulled to 0 V by its 100k in both states: FAST_COMBINED high, PERMIT low
cases.pass_criteria: fault asserted for both OCD levels

cases.name: whole V5 domain slow decay
cases.setup: J1.1 5.0 -> 0 V over 100 ms, wires intact
cases.stimulus: linear decay at OCD 0 V, repeat at OCD 7.5 V
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N follows R7 down; the receiver must read fault before V5I falls below 2.7 V; PERMIT releases
cases.pass_criteria: no sample with FAST_EXT_N > 3.5 V while V(V5I) < 2.7 V; record the crossing and t(PERMIT)

cases.name: recovery
cases.setup: J1.1 0 -> 5.0 V over 100 ms after BF-06
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N returns high only after V5I > 2.7 V; PERMIT stays low until D0's latch is reset by the operator
cases.pass_criteria: record t(FAST_EXT_N high), t(V5I > 2.7 V) and whether PERMIT re-arms without a reset (it must not)

cases.name: rail collapse with OCD live
cases.setup: J1.1 falls 5.0 -> 0 V in < 1 ms while OCD = 15 V
cases.stimulus: abrupt open, C1 hold-up is the only supply
cases.expected: FAST_EXT_N stays low throughout; the module may latch Q1 on or off but never high
cases.pass_criteria: record the line at 100 us and 1 ms; any excursion above 0.4 V fails

notes: expected values are computed from the schematic, not measured; each case is a prediction until the raw trace is attached
PERMIT and FAST_COMBINED are D0 nodes; D0 has no PCB, so BF-05/06/07 need either a D0 prototype or an equivalent receiver on the bench
the V5 current in BF-04 must be measured with a uA meter: the whole point is that the connector carries nothing once D3 is in place

d12_selection.rail_isolation_ref: D3, cathode on V5I / anode on J1.1 V5

land.first_article_check: measure the solder joint on the first built board; the pad is 0.35 mm taller and 0.05 mm wider than the recommendation

worst_case_current.path: D2 from OCD via IN+ into the internal rail V5I while J1.1 is open; D3 blocks the same current from reaching the connector
worst_case_current.note: surge, not continuous; the continuous path is bounded by the divider (~0.44 mA at the design maximum), so the diode current is not the stress -- the rail state below 2.7 V is (see backfeed)

open_items: the SOD-123 vendor land is not the footprint in use; the difference is inside 0.1 mm on centres but the pads are larger
the backfed rail V5I is not characterised in hardware: D3 keeps it away from the connector and from R7, but the state below 2.7 V is unspecified, so the bench matrix (BF-03..BF-08) is unexecuted
no temperature derating is applied to the 230 mW total dissipation

d0_connection: J1.1 V5 -> D0 V5 (bench 5 V rail)
J1.3 OCD -> D0 R8/OCD node (the burden, before R9)
J1.4 FAST_EXT_N -> D0 J10.4 ONLY; U11F inverts before U19 OR with legacy FAST_TRIP

observations.finding: The LM393 is not the bottleneck: the three filters in front of it total ~127.6 us of time constants.
The module trips at 76.6 A peak (7.66 V burden) and releases at 73.7 A; the nominal divider crossing is 75.0 A.
observations.evidence: divider arithmetic against the references/datasheets/tlv3501.txt reference and the project CT transfer 0.1 V/A

observations.finding: Total module delay is ~1.06 us using the 12 ns over-temperature comparator number, about 121x faster than the existing filtered path.
observations.evidence: references/datasheets/tlv3501.txt switching characteristics, overdrive 5 mV, -40 to +125 C

observations.finding: That 121x is detection only. With D0's decode and latch and the SR board's shutdown branch added, the whole-machine stop goes from ~142.5 us to ~14.7 us -- 9.7x -- because the sr branch sets it. Both totals pay their own decode (1.51 us here, 1.40 us on the filtered path) and both stay floors: U6.4 has no published maximum.

The input pin stays inside the common-mode range up to 132 A peak. Above that the comparator is out of range but still inside its absolute maximum, so it is already tripped and the output state no longer matters.
observations.evidence: references/datasheets/tlv3501.txt common-mode range (V-)-0.2 V to (V+)-0.2 V, absolute maximum (V-)-0.3 V to (V+)+0.3 V

observations.finding: The threshold sits above the 73.68 A peak of the frozen short-circuit deck, so that case is left to the controller's own overcurrent. The module is aimed at the 84-101 A severe faults.
observations.evidence: design/v3/power_priority: lr_design.json PHYSICAL_PEAKS and the hotfault prefixes

observations.finding: SHDN tied high would disable the comparator; it is tied to PGND through R8.
observations.evidence: references/datasheets/tlv3501.txt shutdown section: high (within 0.9 V of V+) disables, more than 1.7 V below V+ enables

observations.finding: The module does not latch; the CD4013 on D0 does. Used standalone, the output follows the current.
observations.evidence: D0 J10/U11F/U19 -> FAST_COMBINED -> U6/U10 -> U12 SET

limits: module only; the CT, rectifier and burden stay on D0
the system stop is NOT set by this comparator: the SR branch waits for REG to fall through UVLO, so the whole-machine floor is quoted in system_delay
D0's CD4013 latch propagation is not modelled, so system_delay totals are floors
the module rail is isolated by D3, but the isolated rail can still be backfed through D2; its state below 2.7 V is unspecified and the bench matrix that would pin it down is UNEXECUTED
the LM4040DBZ-2.5 minimum operating current is unverified, so the low-supply corner is not characterised
a clean ERC only says the drawing agrees with itself
